title: Grade 10 Mathematics — Areas Related to Circles
description: Area of circles, sectors, segments, and combined figures
subject: mathematics

questions.question: The area of a sector with radius r and central angle θ° is:
questions.explanation: Area of sector = (θ/360) × πr². This is the fraction θ/360 of the full circle area πr². Arc length = (θ/360) × 2πr.

questions.question: The area of a sector with r = 7 cm and θ = 90° is: (π = 22/7)
The area of a segment equals:
options: Area of sector − Area of the corresponding triangle
Area of circle − Area of sector
Area of sector + Area of triangle
questions.explanation: Area of minor segment = Area of sector (OAB) − Area of triangle (OAB). For major segment = Area of circle − Area of minor segment.

questions.question: The length of an arc with r = 14 cm and θ = 60° is: (π = 22/7)
A horse is tied to a corner of a square field (side 10 m) with a rope of length 5 m. The area it can graze is:
questions.explanation: The horse can graze in a quarter circle (90° at corner of square): Area = (90/360) × π × 5² = (1/4) × 25π = 25π/4 m².

questions.question: If the perimeter of a semicircle is 36 cm, find the radius. (π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Perimeter of semicircle = πr + 2r = r(π + 2) = r(22/7 + 2) = r(36/7). 36/7 × r = 36 → r = 7 cm.

questions.question: A square ABCD is inscribed in a circle of radius r. The area of the square is:
questions.explanation: For a square inscribed in a circle: the diagonal of the square = diameter = 2r. If side = a, diagonal = a√2 = 2r → a = r√2. Area = a² = (r√2)² = 2r².

questions.question: The area of the shaded region if a circle of radius 7 cm is inside a square of side 14 cm is: (π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Area of square = 14² = 196 cm². Area of circle = π × 7² = (22/7) × 49 = 154 cm². Shaded area (corners outside circle) = 196 − 154 = 42 cm².

questions.question: The radius of a circle is increased by 10%. Its area increases by:
questions.explanation: New radius = 1.1r. New area = π(1.1r)² = 1.21πr². Increase = 21%. In general: area scales as (ratio of sides)², so 10% radius increase → 1.1² = 1.21 → 21% area increase.

questions.question: A sector of a circle of radius 12 cm has area 60π cm². Find the central angle.

In a circle of radius 10 cm, a chord subtends a central angle of 60°. The area of the minor segment is:
questions.explanation: Area of sector (60°) = (60/360)π(10²) = 100π/6. Area of equilateral triangle (60° central angle, sides = radius = 10): = (√3/4)(10²) = 25√3. Segment = 100π/6 − 25√3 cm².

questions.question: Two circles of radii 5 cm and 3 cm touch internally. The area between them is:
questions.explanation: Area between = Area of larger circle − Area of smaller circle = π(5²) − π(3²) = 25π − 9π = 16π cm².

questions.question: A wheel has radius 35 cm. How many complete revolutions must it make to cover 1.1 km? (π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2πr = 2 × (22/7) × 35 = 220 cm = 2.2 m. Distance = 1.1 km = 1100 m. Revolutions = 1100/2.2 = 500.
